answer.answer: Yes. The updated Fern CI FAQ now states that Fern CI retains build logs for 30 days [fern-faq-new], so a build-log retention period has been published. This is a change from the earlier FAQ snapshot, which explicitly stated that the build-log retention period was not specified [fern-faq-old]. Both snapshots carry the same subject_id (fern-ci) and lineage_id (fern-faq), so the newer snapshot is an update to the same FAQ for the same subject, not a different entity. The earlier 'not specified' statement remains historically valid as a record of what the FAQ said previously, but it is superseded by the current 30-day disclosure. Remaining unresolved: the supplied snapshots do not indicate when the 30-day policy took effect or was published, and they address only build logs, not any other data categories.
change_events: The Fern CI FAQ changed from stating that the build-log retention period is not specified to stating that Fern CI retains build logs for 30 days [fern-faq-old, fern-faq-new].
